annotations.title: Party Wall Act notices and dates

description: Works out which notice the Party Wall etc. Act 1996 needs (line of junction, section 1; party structure, sections 2 and 3; adjacent excavation within 3 m or 6 m, section 6), and the dates: from `planned_start_date` the latest day to send it by the chosen method (by hand, first or second class post, email if agreed), or from `serve_date` the day it counts as served and the earliest start; plus the neighbour's 14 day reply deadline, when a dispute is deemed to arise, and when the notice lapses (12 months). Uses England and Wales bank holidays to 2028. Returns `notice`, `section`, `dates` (each as YYYY-MM-DD plus plain words), step by step `working`, what the notice must say, warnings and sources. Example: cutting a steel beam into a party wall, work to start 1 March 2027, posted first class: {"work":"insert_beam_or_dpc_into_party_wall","planned_start_date":"2027-03-01","serve_method":"first_class_post"}.

adjoining_owners.description: How many adjoining owners (each gets their own notice). Defaults to 1.

distance_to_neighbour_building_m.description: Excavations: horizontal distance from the excavation to the neighbour's building.

excavation_depth_m.description: Excavations: depth of your excavation or foundation below ground.

nation.description: Defaults to england. The Act applies in England and Wales only.

neighbour_foundation_depth_m.description: Excavations: depth of the neighbour's foundations, if known.

planned_start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Give this or serve_date (or both, to check the start is late enough).

serve_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the day the notice was or will be handed over, posted or emailed.

trade.description: Optional. The builder's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill the contractor details in notices and CDM answers and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Site Pack.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Oakline Building Services".

licence_body.description: Trade body or competent person scheme the business is a member of (the one used for the reference).

licence_number.description: Membership or registration number with that body.
